material: MFR STD STL; approved supplier Thomson Industries, Inc.; Class S steel shafting
finish: HARDENED & GROUND 60 CASE. Heat treatment: VENDORS STD LENGTH "H", RKW C 58-63. Surface texture 63 on the 1.9980 diameter journals; stacked 16/32 marking on the main diameter; K marking at the end-shaft surface texture symbol. Referenced specification 1E122 SURF TEX.
general_tolerance: UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED: THIRD ANGLE PROJECTION; DIMENSIONS IN INCHES; 2 PLACE DIM. ±.020; 3 PLACE DIM. ±.010; ANGULAR DIM. ±1°. Referenced specifications: 1E507 IDENT; 1E122 SURF TEX; 1E500 THD; 1E11 TOL.

views.description: Longitudinal elevation of a solid, stepped, externally threaded tie rod. The central cylindrical length is shortened graphically by a conventional shaft break; hatching at the break is not a separate section view. Both ends have reduced journals, further reduced threaded-end extensions, shoulder radii, and end chamfers.
views.centerline_notes: Horizontal axial centerline shared by all cylindrical steps and external threads. Dashed lines near the ends represent conventional thread minor-diameter geometry, not internal holes. Datum A is the axis established by the main 2.4981 diameter.

views.description: Left end view, consistent with the stated third-angle projection. Concentric circular outlines represent the solid shaft steps and end/thread/chamfer geometry; no bore is indicated.
views.centerline_notes: Crossed horizontal and vertical centerlines establish the common shaft axis. Circular outlines are concentric.

features.description: Solid central cylindrical shaft, diameter 2.4981 and length 39.000 between shoulders. Establish its axis as datum A; preferably use a mid-plane extrusion. The drawing's central break does not remove material.
Two coaxial reduced journals, one on each central-cylinder end face, diameter 1.9980 and length 1.88 each. Implement as two bosses or a mirrored boss.

Two coaxial end extensions, diameter 1.868, extending outward from the reduced journals. Each has derived nominal length 6.370; overall part length is 55.50. These are solid external-thread blanks, not holes.

External 1.875-12-2A threads at both ends, 3.00 minimum thread length each. Exact termination is unspecified; a cosmetic-thread model can preserve the minimum callout without inventing a manufactured runout.
R.030 concave shoulder blends between the main cylinder and each 1.9980 journal, two places.
R.030 concave shoulder blends between each 1.9980 journal and the 1.868 end extension, two places.
External end-edge chamfers, .06 x 45 degrees, one at each free end.

symmetry.plane: Transverse plane through the shaft midpoint, 27.75 from either end
symmetry.description: Nominal end geometry is mirrored. The right end length derived from the overall chain equals the dimensioned left end length. Paired sizes, radii, chamfers, and thread requirements are explicitly marked 2 PLACES; exact thread terminations need not be identical because only minimum lengths are specified.

symmetry.plane: Any longitudinal plane through datum axis A, excluding the helical thread form
symmetry.description: The turned solid envelope is rotationally symmetric about A.

concentric_groups.description: All turned surfaces and external threads share the nominal shaft axis. Main cylinder establishes datum A; reduced journals have the explicit .0005 T.I.R. requirement.

dimension_chains.description: Left reduced end assembly: 8.250 = 1.88 journal + 6.370 end extension.
Right reduced end assembly: 8.250 = 1.88 journal + 6.370 end extension.

warnings: No explicit ASME/ISO/DIN standard designation is visible. Third-angle projection, inch units, class-2A external threads and legacy datum-first tolerance frames are stated or visible; a governing standard edition must not be assumed.
The title-block scale appears to read 1 = 2, interpreted as 1:2. Do not measure geometry from this image; the main view also contains a length break.

The main-cylinder surface texture marking shows stacked 16 and 32. These may express a roughness range, but the exact convention and units require the referenced surface-texture specification or a clearer original. The K marking at the end surface texture symbol likewise requires interpretation. Do not treat these as inch dimensions.
Referenced company specifications 1E507, 1E122, 1E500 and 1E11 are not supplied. Their leading character resembles the digit 1; verify their identifiers against the original.

Heat treatment is transcribed as RKW C 58-63 and HARDENED & GROUND 60 CASE. Do not convert '60 CASE' into an assumed case-depth requirement. Confirm the supplier specification, meaning of H, and permitted hardened length before manufacturing.
External thread callout does not explicitly give a thread-series abbreviation. Preserve 1.875-12-2A rather than adding an unsupported series designation.
The 3.00 thread length is a minimum, not an exact thread termination. No separately dimensioned thread relief or runout geometry is provided.
No internal holes, counterbores, countersinks or tapped holes are shown. The concentric end-view circles and dashed lines at the ends must not be interpreted as bores.
No revision is explicitly identified; the D in 147-D is retained as part of the drawing number.
Angular dimensions use the schema's inch unit field solely because a degree option is unavailable; D006 and its ±1 tolerance are in degrees.
